Roth.boxFamily_eq_image_finsupp_aux✝.{u_1} {σ : Type u_1} (r : σ → ℕ) [Finite ↑(Function.support r)] (B : ℕ) :
  Roth.boxFamily r B =
    AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff '' ↑((Finset.Iic (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite r ⋯)).finsupp fun x ↦ Finset.Icc 0 ↑B)

private theorem Roth.boxFamily_eq_image_finsupp_aux.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (r : σ → ℕ)
  [inst : Finite ↑(Function.support r)] (B : ℕ),
  Roth.boxFamily r B =
    AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff '' ↑((Finset.Iic (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite r ⋯)).finsupp fun x ↦ Finset.Icc 0 ↑B) :=
fun {σ} r [Finite ↑(Function.support r)] B ↦
  Set.ext fun W ↦
    {
      mp := fun hW ↦
        Exists.intro W.coeff
          ⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a) (propext Finset.mem_coe)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a) (propext Finset.mem_finsupp_iff)))
                ⟨fun d hd ↦ Finset.mem_Iic.mpr fun j ↦ LE.le.trans (monomial_le_degreeOf j hd) (hW.left j), fun d x ↦
                  Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (hW.right d)⟩),
            rfl⟩,
      mpr := fun a ↦
        Exists.casesOn a fun c h ↦
          And.casesOn h fun hc right ↦
            right ▸
              And.casesOn (Finset.mem_finsupp_iff.mp hc) fun hs hc ↦
                ⟨fun j ↦ degreeOf_le_iff.mpr fun d hd ↦ Finset.mem_Iic.mp (hs hd) j, fun d ↦
                  if hd : d ∈ Finset.Iic (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite r (Set.toFinite (Function.support r))) then
                    Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hc d hd)
                  else
                    of_eq_true
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congr
                          (congrArg And
                            (Eq.trans (congrArg (LE.le 0) (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp fun h ↦ hd (hs h)))
                              (Std.le_refl._simp_1 0)))
                          (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp fun h ↦ hd (hs h))) ↑B)
                            (Nat.cast_nonneg._simp_1 B)))
                        (and_self True))⟩ }

MAINLEMMA_PRIVATE244_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (r : σ → ℕ) [inst : Finite ↑(Function.support r)] (B : ℕ),
  Roth.boxFamily r B =
    AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff '' ↑((Finset.Iic (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite r ⋯)).finsupp fun (x : σ →₀ ℕ) ↦ Finset.Icc 0 ↑B)
